blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — The Intertropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ) will bring cloudy skies, scattered rain showers and thunderstorms over the Visayas, Mindanao and Palawan on Tuesday, October 6. The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said moderate to at times heavy rains might trigger flash floods and landslides in affected areas.
